properties.description: Fetches one source's raw HTTP response (JSON API or RSS/XML feed) as bytes, unchanged, and lands it at raw/<sourceName>/<sourceName>_<timestamp>.<fileExtension> in the fomoless container. Called per-source, either directly or via PL_Ingest_All_Sources.
Fetches source response. If XML, natively converts to JSON. If JSON, passes through as JSON. Lands all outputs as .json at raw/<sourceName>/<sourceName>_<timestamp>.json

scriptLines: titleUrlDateSummaryTrans derive(canonical_url = iif(isNull(url), lower(trim(regexReplace(title, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', '-'))), url)) ~> urlandsummaryfix

properties.description: Orchestrator. Runs PL_Ingest_Source_Generic once per source, landing raw bytes at raw/<sourceName>/ in the fomoless container. The 8 keyless sources run through the ForEach using sourceConfigs; The Guardian runs as its own activity because it needs an API key that must never be hardcoded into this pipeline.
Orchestrator Copy. Runs PL_Ingest_Source_Generic_Copy to standardize all outputs to JSON.
